old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-m1lv","title":"Rust FragmentSender permit is not bound to the intended remote signer","description":"Final Rule/version security review: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs stores signer in FragmentationPolicyEntry, but AuthenticatedFragmentationPermit exposes only owner/slot/generation and FragmentSender::new accepts no expected remote identity. A permit issued for compatible peer A can therefore authorize fragmentation later transmitted to unknown or mismatched peer B; the constructed sender carries no peer binding that a transport can verify. Require FragmentSender construction to supply and validate the intended remote signer (or return a sender that immutably exposes the policy-resolved signer for link transmission binding), and reject wrong/unknown/mismatched targets.
